newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Shell Australia collieries strike continues.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Shell Australia collieries strike continues.

text.p: Strike action at Shell Australia Ltd's coal mines in central Queensland is continuing and the matter has been referred to the Australian Industrial Relations Commission, a Shell Australia spokesman said on Friday.

Union members at Shell subsidiary Capricorn Coal Management Pty Ltd's Southern, Central and German Creek collieries have been on strike since Wednesday over the dismissal of a union official for gross misconduct.

"There is a legal process prescribed by industrial relations legislation to decide any claims for unfair dismissal, but despite this, the union has taken industrial action," mine general manager Mitch Jakeman said in a statement.
The industrial action follows a 48-hour stoppage earlier this week by members of the construction, forestry, mining and energy union at the Southern Colliery.
Jakeman said the mines were losing A$1 million a day in lost export earnings while the strike continued.
The German Creek mines, comprising two underground mines and an open-cut mine, have a combined production capability of five million tonnes annually for the export metallurgical coal market.
